communities.name: 1. Core Router, State Machine & Design System
communities.description: Entry point, 13-route SPA/PWA screen router (App.tsx), global toast & 30s urgent waitlist call modal, offline banner, TypeScript domain models, and dark-slate theme tokens.

communities.name: 2. Backend, Offline Outbox, Realtime & Graphify Services
communities.description: 8 core services in src/lib/: Supabase client, Offline-First Outbox & SWR profile cache, Postgres Changes realtime manager, Atomic Betting & Wager Settlement, Waitlist Queue manager, Sound synthesizer, and Claude Code Graphify Bridge.

communities.name: 3. Onboarding, Sponsored Ads & Authentication Screens
communities.description: First-run 5-slide onboarding & PWA install guide, 5s sponsored splash ad with 30m cooldown, and full authentication screen (Login, Invite-Code/QR Register, Password Recovery, Guest Mode).

communities.name: 4. Lobby, Match Setup, Scorepad Gameplay & Spectator Live Screens
communities.description: Main HomeScreen dashboard (daily streak bonus, rankings, Pedir Mesa queue, active matches), SetupScreen (2v2/individual, Salida/Mano, VIP Wager), GameScreen (2-column scorepad, substitutions, Zapato, shareable receipt), and LiveMatchScreen (spectator odds betting & live chat).

communities.name: 5. Social Profiles, Store, 50 Achievements, Leaderboards & Tournaments
communities.description: ProfileScreen (stats, VAR MatchGraph, rivals, duos, QR pass, secret admin PIN via verify_admin_pin), StoreScreen (14 cosmetics + 250k custom title), AchievementsScreen (50 achievements), LeaderboardScreen (Ricos/Ganadores/Zapateros), TournamentsScreen (VIP Cash/Brackets/Leaderboard + Admin), and GlobalChatScreen.

communities.name: 6. Reusable Visual, Chart, Camera QR & Legal Components
communities.description: 5 shared components: ProgressChart (animated race bars), MatchGraph ("El VAR del Dominó" polyline chart), QRScannerModal (Web camera + jsQR + image upload), RainbowText (animated VIP gradient), and LegalModal (5 compliance tabs).

communities.name: 7. Supabase Database Schema, 11 Tables, 4 RPCs & Maintenance SQL
communities.description: PostgreSQL schema, RLS policies, 8 performance indexes, Realtime publication, 11 database tables, and 4 SECURITY DEFINER / maintenance RPCs.

communities.name: 8. PWA Service Worker, Build Pipeline & Deployment Config
communities.description: Offline-First Service Worker (public/sw.js), Web App Manifest, postbuild HTML/CSS injector, Vercel SPA routing config, Expo app.json, and Graphify CLI analyzer.

nodes.label: index.ts (Expo Root Entry)
nodes.role: Registers root App component with Expo registerRootComponent.

nodes.label: App.tsx (13-Route State Machine & Global Overlays)
nodes.role: Central router managing 13 ScreenStates, session & password recovery, version gate (system_config.min_app_version), global chat toast, 30s urgent waitlist call modal, offline sync status banner, and Graphify controller registration.
uiElements: Offline Sync Banner (sincronizando / cola offline)
Global Chat & Bet Won Animated Toast
30s Urgent Waitlist Call Modal (¡A LA MESA!)
Outdated Version Gate Screen

nodes.label: src/types.ts (Domain Type Definitions)
nodes.role: Defines Team, GameMode, Player, Round, Substitution, Match, and Profile interfaces.

nodes.label: src/theme.ts (Dark-Slate UI Theme Tokens)
nodes.role: Centralizes colors (#0f172a background, #1e293b card, #3b82f6 team1, #10b981 team2, #f59e0b accent), spacing, typography, and borderRadius.

nodes.label: supabase.ts (Supabase Auth & PostgREST Client)
nodes.role: Initializes @supabase/supabase-js client with AsyncStorage session persistence and URL token detection on Web.

nodes.label: offlineSync.ts (Offline-First Outbox & SWR Cache)
nodes.role: Provides Stale-While-Revalidate profile & match caching, UUIDv4 generation, online/offline detection, and a persistent FIFO Outbox Queue (@domino_offline_queue_v1) that syncs offline matches to Supabase upon reconnection.

nodes.label: realtimeManager.ts (Postgres Realtime Channels)
nodes.role: Manages the singleton waitlist channel (domino_waitlist_calls) and per-match channels (sync_match_<id>). Everything comes from Postgres Changes: table calls and near-turn notices are waitlist columns only the server writes, so nobody can spoof them.

nodes.label: bettingService.ts (Atomic Betting, Wager Settlement & Self-Healing)
nodes.role: Handles placeMatchBet (with rollback on error), settleMatchBetsAndWagers (invoking SECURITY DEFINER RPCs resolve_match_bets & resolve_match_wagers + client fallback), and reconcileUserPendingBets (self-healing payout credit on login/mount).

nodes.label: waitlistService.ts (Pedir Mesa Queue & 30s Call Service)
nodes.role: Fetches active waitlist enriched with cached profiles (avoiding PostgREST FK join errors), validates duplicate entries, inserts/updates/cancels queue turns, and asks the server to make 30s urgent calls (call_waitlist_duo).

nodes.label: sounds.ts (Audio Effects & Mute Manager)
nodes.role: Plays 4 sound effects (pop.mp3, slap.mp3, clap.mp3, chaching.mp3) via expo-av with persistent mute toggle.

nodes.label: graphifyBridge.ts (Claude Code Runtime QA & Navigation Bridge)
nodes.role: Exposes window.__DOMINO_GRAPHIFY__ with FULL_SYSTEM_GRAPH_MANIFEST, programmatic navigate(screen, opts), uiTestHelpers (toast/waitlist modal triggers), direct service hooks, and runDiagnostics().

nodes.label: OnboardingScreen.tsx (5-Slide Tutorial & PWA Install Guide)
nodes.role: Interactive 5-slide onboarding covering Welcome, VAR MatchGraph, VIP Tournaments, Store & 50 Medals, and Push Notification permission + iOS/Android PWA install modals.
uiElements: Slide 1-5 Carousel & Dot Indicators
Activar Alertas (Notification.requestPermission)
Guía iPhone (Safari Compartir -> Agregar a Inicio)
Guía Android (Chrome ⋮ -> Instalar aplicación)
Saltar / ¡Entrar a la Mesa! CTA

nodes.label: SplashAdScreen.tsx (Sponsored Ad Interstitial)
nodes.role: 5-second countdown interstitial pulling active ads from Supabase ads table (with fallback ads) and external link opener, gated by a 30-minute cooldown.

Full-bleed Ad Image & Clickable Link Banner
Saltar Publicidad ➔ Button

nodes.label: SetupScreen.tsx (Match Configuration, Salida & VIP Wager)

nodes.label: GameScreen.tsx (Live Scorepad, Substitutions, Winner & Share)
nodes.role: Active match scorepad: tracks rounds (normal, trancado, tie), dynamic Mano/Salida indicator, ProgressChart, undo last round, mid-game player substitution (teamScoreAtSub >= 50 rule), proximity alert at limit-10, Winner Modal with Zapato 👟 badge, view-shot receipt sharing, duo registration prompt, and "🚨 Llamar Siguiente Dúo".

nodes.label: LiveMatchScreen.tsx (Spectator Scoreboard, Odds Betting & Chat)

nodes.label: supabase_schema.sql (Base Database Schema)
nodes.role: Initial PostgreSQL table definitions for profiles, matches, waitlist, bets, duos, live_chat, global_chat, and tournaments.

nodes.label: supabase_maintenance_fix.sql (Idempotent Maintenance, Indexes, RLS & RPCs)
nodes.role: Production maintenance migration adding missing columns (creator_id, is_wager_match, wager_amount), permissive waitlist/bets RLS policies, 8 performance indexes, SECURITY DEFINER RPCs (resolve_match_bets, resolve_match_wagers), and supabase_realtime publication.

nodes.label: clean_today.sql (Daily Match Cleanup Utility)
nodes.role: Admin SQL script to purge matches created on the current day.

nodes.label: clean_only_tests.sql (Test Data Cleanup Utility)
nodes.role: Admin SQL script to remove test matches while preserving production records.

nodes.label: Table: public.profiles
nodes.role: Stores user profiles, betting_points, inventory, equipped_items, achievements, streak_count, last_streak_update_at, and is_admin.

nodes.label: Table: public.matches
nodes.role: Stores active and completed matches, team totals, rounds JSONB, players_json, substitutions, is_wager_match, wager_amount, and tournament_id.

nodes.label: Table: public.waitlist
nodes.role: Stores Pedir Mesa queue entries (creator_id, player1_id, player2_id, status: waiting/playing/cancelled).

nodes.label: Table: public.bets
nodes.role: Stores spectator bets (user_id, match_id, bet_on_team, amount_wagered, multiplier, status: pending/won/lost).

nodes.label: Table: public.duos
nodes.role: Stores official player partnerships (player1_id, player2_id, is_active).

nodes.label: Table: public.live_chat
nodes.role: Stores per-match spectator chat messages.

nodes.label: Table: public.global_chat
nodes.role: Stores global lobby chat messages.

nodes.label: Table: public.tournaments
nodes.role: Stores VIP Cash, Brackets, and Leaderboard tournaments.

nodes.label: Table: public.tournament_participants
nodes.role: Stores tournament registrations, payment receipts, partner_id, and Pago Móvil payout details.

nodes.label: Table: public.tournament_brackets
nodes.role: Stores tournament bracket pairings linked to live_match_id.

nodes.label: Table: public.ads
nodes.role: Stores active splash screen advertisements.

nodes.label: Table: public.system_config
nodes.role: Single-row app config (id=1) read by App.tsx for the min_app_version update gate.

nodes.label: Storage Bucket: avatars
nodes.role: Profile picture uploads from ProfileScreen.

nodes.label: Storage Bucket: receipts
nodes.role: VIP Cash tournament payment receipt uploads from TournamentsScreen.

nodes.label: RPC: verify_admin_pin (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Verifies the secret admin PIN server-side and persists is_admin (fix_admin_pin.sql).

nodes.label: RPC: delete_user_account (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Deletes the caller account and its data (delete_account_rpc.sql), invoked from ProfileScreen.

nodes.label: RPC: cancel_tournament_and_refund
nodes.role: Cancels a tournament and refunds participants, invoked from TournamentsScreen admin panel.

nodes.label: RPC: resolve_match_bets (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Atomically credits FLOOR(amount_wagered * multiplier) to winning bettors in profiles.betting_points and marks bets won/lost (or refunds cancelled matches). Server-only since fix_points_security.sql: run by the match-completion trigger and settle_completed_match.

nodes.label: RPC: resolve_match_wagers (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Atomically transfers wager_amount between winning and losing players in VIP Wager matches.

nodes.label: RPC: update_player_streaks_for_match
nodes.role: Updates player streak counters when a match completes.

nodes.label: RPC: clean_old_tournaments
nodes.role: Purges expired tournaments older than 15 days.

nodes.label: RPC: place_bet (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Locks the balance, computes the 1.20x-3.50x multiplier, inserts the bet and deducts points in one transaction.

nodes.label: RPC: settle_completed_match (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Settles bets and wagers of a completed match using the winner stored in the match row.

nodes.label: RPC: settle_my_pending_bets (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Settles the caller pending bets on completed matches and returns won_count, total_credited, new_balance.

nodes.label: RPC: buy_store_item (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Charges the server-side catalog price, adds the item to inventory and auto-equips it (custom titles 1-20 chars).

nodes.label: RPC: claim_achievement (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Pays the server-side reward of one of the 50 achievements, once per user.

nodes.label: RPC: claim_daily_bonus (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Credits the +10 daily bonus once per day (day starts 7 AM America/Caracas).

nodes.label: RPC: join_tournament_with_points (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Charges entry_points, registers the caller as approved and grows prize_pool.

nodes.label: RPC: award_tournament_prize (SECURITY DEFINER)
nodes.role: Pays the prize pool once to the champions of the final bracket and marks the tournament completed.

nodes.label: public/sw.js (Offline-First Service Worker v3)
nodes.role: Caches app shell & static bundles (Cache-First + Stale-While-Revalidate) so the web app boots and plays matches 100% offline.

nodes.label: public/manifest.json (PWA Web Manifest)
nodes.role: Configures standalone display mode, icons, and dark theme color (#0f172a) for iOS/Android home screen installation.

nodes.label: scripts/postbuild.js (PWA Meta & SW Registration Injector)
nodes.role: Injects PWA meta tags, viewport rules, and Service Worker registration into dist/index.html after expo export.

nodes.label: vercel.json (Vercel SPA Rewrite & Cache Headers)
nodes.role: Configures expo export -p web build command, static asset caching, and SPA fallback rewrites.

nodes.label: package.json (Dependencies & Build/Graphify Scripts)
nodes.role: Defines dependencies (Expo, React Native Web, Supabase, jsQR) and scripts (web, build, graphify).

nodes.label: app.json
nodes.role: Expo app config (name, icons, web/PWA settings).

nodes.label: eas.json
nodes.role: EAS Build profiles for native builds.

nodes.label: tsconfig.json
nodes.role: TypeScript compiler config (npx tsc --noEmit).

nodes.label: scripts/graphify.js
nodes.role: This Graphify generator: builds graph.json, GRAPH_REPORT.md, qa_matrix.json and graph.html.

nodes.label: LiveTableGames.tsx
nodes.role: Home list of table games being played now. Hidden when there are none.

nodes.label: MatchHistoryRow.tsx
nodes.role: One domino match seen from a player, with the VAR graph on tap. Used by the recent matches card and PlayerMatchesSheet.

nodes.label: PendingConfirmations.tsx
nodes.role: Home cards: results an admin can still resolve, and the notice for matches a rival reopened. The server decides who may answer.

nodes.label: PlayerChip.tsx
nodes.role: A registered player with photo and name, the same chip in Domino, UNO and poker setup.

nodes.label: PlayerMatchesSheet.tsx
nodes.role: Sheet opened from a rival or duo in the profile: their whole match list with the won/lost record on top.

nodes.label: PointsHistory.tsx
nodes.role: Own-profile list of the last 30 point movements from points_ledger.

nodes.label: PokerChips.tsx
nodes.role: Drawn poker chip and chip tower.

nodes.label: PokerHandPanel.tsx
nodes.role: The hand in play: pot, each seat, raise, call and fold, and the showdown with ties, the odd chip and the all-in split the dealer writes.

nodes.label: PokerHelpModal.tsx
nodes.role: Table of the 10 poker hands, best first.

nodes.label: PokerNewHand.tsx
nodes.role: Before each hand: who deals (next in the ring by default), who enters, and "solo reparte".

nodes.label: PokerPot.tsx
nodes.role: The middle of the poker table: the pot drawn as a pile of chips in the tray colors, growing with each bet.

nodes.label: PokerTable.tsx
nodes.role: Felt view everyone sees during a hand: the pot and how each seat stands.

nodes.label: PokerTray.tsx
nodes.role: Each player tray on their own phone: chip towers that scale with the entry, tap to bet, then equal, raise or fold.

nodes.label: ResultConfirmationPrompt.tsx
nodes.role: Full-screen window mounted in App.tsx: asks the rival team to confirm or reject a finished match, with the 1-minute countdown on normal matches.

nodes.label: RosterPicker.tsx
nodes.role: Choose the players of a table game, with or without an account. Poker uses it in seat order.

nodes.label: TableGameConfirmationPrompt.tsx
nodes.role: Full-screen window mounted in App.tsx: asks the other players of a table game to confirm the winner, with the 1-minute countdown.

nodes.label: TableGameRanking.tsx
nodes.role: Home ranking for one UNO variant, from the table_game_ranking RPC.

nodes.label: WagerConsent.tsx
nodes.role: WagerConsentPrompt (60s accept/decline shown on each of the 4 phones, mounted globally in App.tsx) and WagerStatusBanner (live proposal state in GameScreen). Reads wager_consents via realtime; writes only through respond_wager.

nodes.label: gameTabs.ts
nodes.role: The games in the bottom bar and the swipe rules. Covered by tests/gameTabs.test.mjs.

nodes.label: inviteQr.ts
nodes.role: Builds the invite QR on the device, with no outside service. Covered by tests/inviteQr.test.mjs, which scans the result back.

nodes.label: matchRivals.ts
nodes.role: Pure rule mirroring _match_rivals: who answers for a closed match, used only to choose which buttons to show. Covered by tests/matchRivals.test.mjs.

nodes.label: outbox.ts
nodes.role: Pure rule of the offline outbox: an item leaves the queue only when the server confirmed that exact payload. Covered by tests/outbox.test.mjs.

nodes.label: playerHistory.ts
nodes.role: Pure rules of a profile: matches against a rival, matches next to a partner, won/lost record and how a bet ended. Covered by tests/playerHistory.test.mjs.

nodes.label: poker.ts
nodes.role: Pure poker rules. Table chips stay inside a game and come from the closed hands; the server checks each closed hand again. Covered by tests/poker.test.mjs.

nodes.label: pushNotifications.ts
nodes.role: Registers this device for Web Push (permission, PushManager, save_push_subscription) and removes it on logout. The server sends through the send-push Edge Function.

nodes.label: tableGameService.ts
nodes.role: Reads and RPCs for table games. Starting and finishing go through the offline outbox when there is no connection.

nodes.label: tableGames.ts
nodes.role: Pure rules for table games (UNO and its variants): labels, roster size, who manages and who answers. Mirrors the server. Covered by tests/tableGames.test.mjs.

nodes.label: useGameSwipe.ts
nodes.role: Swipe between games in Home: the content follows the finger and settles in from the side it came from.

nodes.label: webAlert.ts
nodes.role: Maps Alert.alert to window.alert/confirm on web (react-native-web ships it empty). Imported first in index.ts; with 3+ buttons only the main and cancel actions survive.

nodes.label: PokerScreen.tsx
nodes.role: Route poker: table chips, who deals, who enters, betting, closing a hand, correcting the last one, finishing the game and the live view for everyone else.

nodes.label: UnoScreen.tsx
nodes.role: Route uno: choose the variant and players (with or without an account), play, mark the winner, wait for confirmation and rematch. Also the live view for the rest of the club and the list of recent games.

nodes.label: points_ledger
nodes.role: Every balance change with its reason, written by a trigger on profiles.betting_points. Readable by its owner and admins.

nodes.label: wager_consents
nodes.role: One row per player/match for the VIP wager consent (status, team, expires_at). Written only by RPCs.

nodes.label: poker_hands
nodes.role: Each poker hand: who dealt and entered, what each put in, winners, hand and who wrote it. Chips are computed from it, never stored.

nodes.label: table_games
nodes.role: UNO games and their state. The app only reads it: every change goes through the table game RPCs.

nodes.label: tournament_payouts
nodes.role: Private bank data for tournament payouts, readable only by its owner and admins. Filled by a trigger from tournament_participants.payout_details.

nodes.label: propose_wager
nodes.role: Sends the VIP wager proposal to the 4 players (60s). Match must be unstarted.

nodes.label: seat_waitlist_entry
nodes.role: Marks a duo as playing: the duo, an admin, or the creator of the match they sit at.

nodes.label: award_zapatero_maestro
nodes.role: Grants the Zapatero Maestro achievement after the server counts 3 zapatos given.

nodes.label: respond_wager
nodes.role: One player accepts/declines; on 4 accepts it re-checks balances and activates the wager.

nodes.label: confirm_match_result
nodes.role: A rival or admin accepts a pending result; marks it completed and pays in one transaction.

nodes.label: dispute_match_result
nodes.role: A rival or admin rejects a pending result; removes the last hand and reopens the match.

nodes.label: finish_expired_match
nodes.role: Closes a normal match whose countdown ended; the server checks the time and that nothing is at stake.

nodes.label: save_push_subscription
nodes.role: Registers a device for push notifications under the signed-in user.

nodes.label: remove_push_subscription
nodes.role: Removes the signed-in user's device from push notifications on logout.

nodes.label: cancel_poker_hand
nodes.role: Removes a hand opened by mistake, only while it is open.

nodes.label: cancel_table_game
nodes.role: Someone at the table annuls a game still being played. A sent result can no longer be annulled.

nodes.label: answer_table_game
nodes.role: Another player confirms the winner, which pays the prize, or sends the game back to active.

nodes.label: finish_expired_table_game
nodes.role: Closes a table game whose countdown ended; the server checks the time.

nodes.label: poker_ranking
nodes.role: Wins, games, hands played and best winning hand per player, for one period.

nodes.label: table_game_ranking
nodes.role: Wins and games played per player for one UNO variant and period.

nodes.label: call_waitlist_duo
nodes.role: Someone at a table or an admin calls a duo; the phones listen to the waitlist row the server writes.

nodes.label: notify_near_turn
nodes.role: A table warns the first duo in line when it is 10 points from the end, using the score stored on the server.

nodes.label: invite_tournament_partner
nodes.role: Invites a partner; updates both participant rows and confirms crossed invitations.

nodes.label: respond_tournament_partner
nodes.role: Accepts or rejects a pending tournament partner invitation.

nodes.label: start_tournament
nodes.role: Creator/admin starts: pairs duos, builds round 1 and live matches.

nodes.label: expire_tournament_registration
nodes.role: After 5 minutes starts the tournament or cancels and refunds.

hyperedges.name: VIP Wager Consent & Settlement
hyperedges.description: The match starts without a wager; propose_wager asks the 4 players, respond_wager activates it when all accept in time, and resolve_match_wagers settles between those 4 even after substitutions.

hyperedges.name: Offline-First Match Creation, Scorepad Play & Outbox Flush Pipeline
hyperedges.description: Allows players to configure and play an entire domino match with zero internet connection. Rounds are persisted to @domino_active_match and queued in @domino_offline_queue_v1, then automatically flushed to public.matches when connectivity returns.

hyperedges.name: Live Match Score & Spectator Sync
hyperedges.description: Every round scored in GameScreen is saved to public.matches; spectators receive it through Postgres Changes on channel sync_match_<id>. Broadcast is not used because it cannot prove who sent a message.

hyperedges.name: Pedir Mesa Queue, 30s Urgent Call & Instant Table Setup
hyperedges.description: End-to-end table queue: players join with a partner from HomeScreen or LiveMatchScreen, active tables trigger a 30s urgent call modal via domino_waitlist_calls, and clicking "🎲 Pasar" pre-fills SetupScreen with the waiting duo.

hyperedges.name: Spectator Odds Betting, VIP Match Wagers & Server-Side Payout Settlement
hyperedges.description: All point movements happen on the server: place_bet deducts and records bets atomically, the match-completion trigger (and settle_completed_match as safety net) pays winners using the winner stored in the match, and reconcileUserPendingBets() calls settle_my_pending_bets on login/HomeScreen/ProfileScreen. A profiles trigger blocks direct client writes to betting_points.

hyperedges.name: Points Economy: Daily Streak, 50 Achievements, VIP Store & Leaderboards
hyperedges.description: Players earn betting_points from daily streaks (+10/day), match wins, bets, and 50 achievements, then spend them in StoreScreen on titles, RainbowText colors, borders, and table felt colors displayed across Rankings, Profiles, and GlobalChat.

hyperedges.name: VIP Cash, Elimination Brackets & Leaderboard Tournaments Lifecycle
hyperedges.description: Handles tournament creation, partner registration, Bs payment receipt uploads, admin approval, automated bracket pairing, live match linking (live_match_id), and automatic winner advancement.
